note: Known axe-core findings per component. Regenerate with `npm run a11y:baseline` after fixing or accepting a finding.

knownIssues.why: The range and week pickers use the Base UI popover trigger directly on their input, which renders `<input role="button">`; ARIA in HTML does not allow the button role on a text input.
knownIssues.next: ACCEPTED by the owner on 2026-11-13: keep the input trigger. The planned fix instead gives both pickers the editable-input plus separate calendar-button pattern the single date picker already uses, which removes this finding as a side effect.

knownIssues.why: The closable-tabs demo keeps the "Add tab" button inside `role="tablist"`, which ARIA says may only contain tabs.
knownIssues.next: Probe result: moving a button out of the tablist is the only fix that clears the rule. The owner chose on 2026-11-13 to keep the current visual grouping, so this critical finding is accepted. Revisit only if the add control can move outside the tab row without changing the layout.
